result.instructions: Tools for Knock, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Did the password-reset workflow run for user 4821 today?"; "Show the delivery logs for the last failed email message."; "List tenants and find the one named Acme.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Knock data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run knock_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run knock_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run knock_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. knock_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: knock_trigger_workflow
tools.title: Trigger a workflow
tools.description: Run a Knock workflow for the given recipients. This SENDS real notifications through the channels the workflow defines (email, SMS, push, in-app). Set cancellation_key to cancel the run later. Knock API: POST /v1/workflows/{key}/trigger.

key.description: The workflow key (from the Knock dashboard).

items.description: A user id string, or an object that identifies a user or object (id plus optional properties).

data.description: Data passed into the workflow run (max 10 MB).

actor.description: The user or object that caused the event.

tenant.description: Tenant id, to use tenant-level overrides.

cancellation_key.description: Key to cancel this run later with knock_cancel_workflow.

tools.name: knock_cancel_workflow
tools.title: Cancel queued workflow runs
tools.description: Cancel queued runs of a workflow that match a cancellation_key set when the run was triggered. Runs already sent cannot be recalled. Knock API: POST /v1/workflows/{key}/cancel.

cancellation_key.description: The cancellation key used when the run was triggered.

recipients.description: Only cancel for these recipients (default: all recipients of the key).

items.description: A user id string, or an object that identifies a user or object (id plus optional properties).
